about_short_description.short_description: Catena Biosciences is a biotechnology company that offers protein conjugation, building biologic structures, and medical research.

product.name: CysTyr Platform
product.description: A platform that uses the Catenase enzyme to form C-Y Bonds between tyrosine and cysteine residues, enabling the attachment of multiple different cargoes to a protein.

product.name: Multi-Payload Conjugate (MPC) Technology
product.description: A technology that combines two payloads with different mechanisms of action on a single antibody to create targeted combination therapies.

product.name: Catenase Enzyme
product.description: An enzyme that catalyzes the formation of C-Y Bonds between tyrosine and cysteine residues, used in the CysTyr platform for protein conjugation.
